blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recently Large Language Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents increasingly need to incorporate knowledge acquired after pretraining, e.g., domain facts, user preferences, documents, and interaction experience. In-context learning (ICL) and ICL-based agent harness remain flexible, but they consume context capacity and incur repeated discretized encoding cost that grows with context length. In-parameter memory offers a complementary substrate: reusable memory information is represented in model parameters, adapters, or other parameter-like objects that are composed into the forward pass at inference time. This survey focuses on methods that augment LLMs with such parametric memory at deployment: a memory-bearing parameter object is plugged into the forward pass during inference, whether it is acquired before or during deployment. We organize the landscape with two orthogonal axes: Parameter Placement , which includes Embedding, Attention, FFN layers, or Hybrid when two or more layers are used; and Parameter Acquisition Time , which distinguishes methods whose memory object is acquired during deployment (online) from those acquired before it (offline). We clarify boundaries, conduct comparisons, and discuss open directions in interference, safety, co-design with ICL, and recursive self-improvement.
blocks.zh: 最近,大型语言模型(LLM)和基于LLM的代理商越来越需要纳入经过预先培训后获得的知识,例如域名事实、用户偏好、文件和互动经验。 内接式学习(ICL)和以ICL为主的代理使用仍然具有灵活性,但它们消耗了上下文能力并产生反复的盘式编码成本,随着上下文长度的增长而增加. 参数内存提供了一个互补的底物:可再使用的内存信息被以模型参数,适配器来表示,或者由推论时间组成前传的其他参数等对象. 本调查的重点是在部署时用这种参数存储器来增强LLMS的方法:在推断时,无论是在部署之前还是部署期间,都把一个有内存的参数对象插入前方通道。 我们用两个正交轴来组织地平面:参数放置(包括嵌入、注意、FFN地平面,或使用两个或两个以上地平面时的混合地平面);参数获取时间(将部署期间(在线)获得的内存物体的方法与部署前(离线)获得的方法区分开来。 我们澄清界限,进行比较,并讨论干扰、安全、与ICL共同设计以及递归自我改进方面的开放方向。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents have demonstrated broad capabilities in natural language generation, reasoning, and tool use ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Achiam et al., 2023 ) . A persistent challenge is how to incorporate knowledge that is external to, or more recent than, pretraining, including new documents, domain-specific constraints, users’ preferences, and experience accumulated over agentic interactions ( Lewis et al., 2020 ; Huang et al., 2026a ; Xu and Yan, 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ; Ni et al., 2026 ) , which we term as memory for LLMs in this survey.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)和基于LLM的代理在自然语言生成,推理,和工具使用方面表现出了广泛的能力(Brown等,2020;Achiam等,2023.). 一个持续的挑战是如何纳入超出或超过预训的知识,包括新文件、特定域的限制、用户的偏好以及因代理互动而积累的经验(Lewis等,2020年;Huang等,2026年a;徐和燕等,2026年;Han等,2026年;Ni等,2026年),我们在本调查中称之为LLMs的内存。

blocks.en: Currently most of the deployed systems expose this information as explicit textual tokens, which is also known as in-context learning (ICL) methods ( Dong et al., 2024 ) . ICL conditions a frozen model on textual demonstrations or retrieved documents as the memory, which is the most common paradigm used by various retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods ( Gao et al., 2023 ; Fan et al., 2024 ; Brown et al., 2020 ; Lewis et al., 2020 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) and agents ( Ying et al., 2026 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) . Though these ICL-based methods for memory augmentations are explainable, inspectable and easy to revise, their compute and latency grow with the number of retrieved tokens, and long contexts can exhaust a finite window ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . Although sparse attention ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2024 ) and KV cache compression ( Rehg, 2024 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2024 ) alleviate but do not remove this scaling.
blocks.zh: 目前大多数部署的系统都将这些信息暴露为明确的文字符号,这也被称为内文学习(ICL)方法(Dong等,2024年). ICL将被冻结的模型以文字演示或取回的文档作为内存,这是各种取回生成(RAG)方法(Gao等,2023;Fan等,2024;Brown等,2020;Lewis等,2020;Huang等,2025)和代理(Ying等,2026;DeepSeek-AI,2026)所使用的最常用范例. 虽然这些基于ICL的内存增强方法可以解释,可以检查并易于修改,但其计算和耐用随着被取回的代币数量的增长而增加,而较长的背景可以耗尽有限的窗口(Vaswani等,2017;Liu等,2024). 虽然注意不多(张等,2025;赖等,2026;刘等,2025;袁等,2025;唐等,2024)和KV缓存压缩(雷克. 2024; Kim等, 2026; Cai等, 2024)缓解了但并未去除这个缩放.

blocks.en: In-parameter memory (IPM) ( Fleshman and Van Durme, 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026b ; Lei et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026e ) provides a complementary memory representation and augmentation paradigm. Instead of exposing all relevant information as explicit textual tokens, the system composes a compressed parametric memory object into the forward pass at inference time. The backbone parameters θ \theta may stay frozen, or the augmentation step may write into them; what matters is that a memory object ϕ \phi is acquired and then composed at deployment. The memory object may be acquired before deployment (offline) or produced and revised during deployment (online). Compared with ICL-based methods, this paradigm can avoid the quadratic cost of long-context prefilling ( McDermott et al., 2026 ) and reduce inference latency when memory is reused across queries. This motivates a significant shift from ICL-based to in-parameter memory augmentation ( Back et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 参数内存(IPM)(Fleshman and Van Durme, 2025;Huang等, 2026b;Lei等, 2026;Zhang等, 2026e)提供了一个互补的内存表现和增强范式. 系统不把所有相关信息都暴露为明确的文字符号,而是在推断时间将压缩的参数记忆对象编成前传. 骨干参数\\theta可能保持被冻结,或者增强步骤可能写入它们;重要的是,一个内存对象\\\phi被获得,然后在部署时组成。 内存对象可以在部署(离线)前获得,或在部署(上线)期间被制作和修改. 与基于ICL的方法相比,这个范式可以避免长文本预填的四重成本(McDermott等,2026年),并减少记忆被反复使用时的推论延迟. 这促使人们从基于ICL到参数内内存增强的重大转变(Back等,2026.).

blocks.en:
To highlight this ongoing shift, in this paper, we provide a focused overview and detailed discussion of the current research progress on in-parameter memory augmentation for LLMs.
As shown in Figure 1 , we organize the in-parameter memory augmentation methods along two orthogonal dimensions: (1) Parameter Placement asks which part of the transformer block receives the parametric memory, including Embedding Layers, Attention Layers, FFN Layers, or Hybrid when two or more of these are used together. (2) Parameter Acquisition Time asks whether the deployed memory object is formed before the model starts serving (offline) or while it is serving (online).
Concurrent architecture-centric surveys ( Zhoubian et al., 2026 ) cover memory broadly, including implicit computation-coupled memory (KV caches, SSMs, MoE) and parameter-efficient adaptation. We treat unmodified token-derived KV caches as token memory rather than in-parameter memory: they are a byproduct of prefilling, not an object produced by an independent acquisition operator 𝒜 \mathcal{A} . We index the remaining composable objects by target-module placement, acquisition timing, and deployment lifecycle (Section 2 ).

blocks.en: 2 Formulation and Scope
blocks.zh: 2 拟订和范围

blocks.en: 2.1 Transformer Backbones and Memory-Able Sites
blocks.zh: 2.1 变形器后骨和可记忆站点

blocks.en: Although nowadays there are many variants of the transformer backbone, their basic building blocks are still almost the same ( Xu et al., 2026a ; Qiu et al., 2026 ; Team et al., 2026 ) . The common transformer block composes an embedding layer, multi-head attention, a feed-forward network (FFN or FFN-based MoE, we use FFN to refer to both), residual connections, and normalization ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . In-parameter memory does not aim to replace this anatomy, but injects a memory object ϕ \phi into one or more of its sites. Two lines of evidence show where such injection is natural. First, FFN layers behave as key-value memories, and attribution studies link specific neurons and layers to factual associations ( Geva et al., 2021 ; Dai et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2022 ) . Second, attention itself is an associative operator: ordinary self-attention accumulates token-derived key-value pairs in a growing cache, while linear-attention and fast-weight variants compress associations into a fixed-size state ( Schlag et al., 2021 ) . These observations motivate three placement families, defined by where IPM ϕ \phi is stored or read: • Embedding layer: ϕ \phi enters as continuous prompt tokens, prefixes, or latent input states appended before the first block. • Attention layer: ϕ \phi participates in attention as keys/values, attention-side adapters, or matrix-valued associative states. • FFN layer: ϕ \phi is stored in feed-forward parameters or FFN-substituting projections. A method is Hybrid when its deployed ϕ \phi uses two or more of these families. The sites differ in read path, capacity, update cost, and compatibility with pretrained checkpoints, which is why placement is one important axis of the taxonomy.

blocks.en: 2.3 Scope and Relation to Neighboring Paradigms
blocks.zh: 2.3 范围和与邻里典范的关系

blocks.en: Table 1 applies the three tests to neighboring paradigms. Pluggable PEFT passes all three: the adapter is a continuous parameter object, trained by its own 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , and still plugged into the forward pass at deployment ( Hu et al., 2021 ; Li and Liang, 2021 ; Lester et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2022 ) . Full-parameter SFT fails the last test, because the update is merged into θ \theta before serving and leaves no distinct object for 𝒞 \mathcal{C} to augment. An unmodified KV cache fails independent acquisition: its entries are a byproduct of prefilling discrete tokens, even though the stored tensors are continuous ( Rehg, 2024 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2024 ) . Encoded KV banks remain inside the boundary ( Huang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Yu et al., 2026b ; De Jong et al., 2021 ) , because an encoder is an independent 𝒜 \mathcal{A} and the LLM reads the resulting parameters rather than a raw token stream. A learned write rule that emits a parameter-like state is included on the same grounds ( Lei et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; von Oswald et al., 2026 ; Bansal et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 表1将三个测试应用于相邻的范式. 可插接的PEFT通过全部三个:适配器为连续参数对象,由自有的A\mathcal{A}来训练,在部署时仍能插入前传(Hu等,2021;Li和Liang,2021;Lester等,2021;Liu等,2022). 完整参数 SFT失败了上次的测试, 因为更新在服务前被合并到 \\theta 中, 并且没有给 C\ mathcal{ C} 添加一个单独的对象 。 未修改的 KV 缓存失败 独立获取 : 它的条目是预填离散符号的副产品, 尽管存储的活度是连续的( Rehg, 2024; Kim等, 2026; Cai等, 2024.). 编码的KV银行仍然在边界内(黄克等,2026b;王克等,2025a;于克等,2026b;德宗等,2021),因为编码器是独立的A\mathcal{A},而LLM读取了由此产生的参数,而不是原始的令牌流. 一项有学识的写作规则,即出出一个类似参数的状态是基于同样的理由(Lei等,2026;Feng等,2026;von Oswald等,2026;Bansal等,2026.).

blocks.en: Continual learning (CL) studies how to absorb new knowledge over a sequence of tasks while mitigating catastrophic forgetting ( Shi et al., 2025 ) . Its canonical mechanisms perform knowledge augmentation by offline training of the model parameters themselves, consolidating each new task before the model is served ( Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ) . Recent LLM transfers converge toward IPM ( Lin et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2026b ) , which maybe acquire ϕ \phi in an offline stage but augment it at inference, so they enter our taxonomy as offline-acquired methods. The dividing line between CL and IPM is whether ϕ \phi is still augmented at deployment.
blocks.zh: 继续学习(CL)研究如何在一系列任务中吸收新知识,同时减轻灾难性的遗忘(Shi等,2025年)。 它的犬科机制通过对模型参数本身进行线下培训来进行知识增强,在模型得到服务之前将每个新任务合并(Kirkpatrick等,2017年). 近期的LLM转移集中到IPM上(Lin等人,2025a; 徐等,2026b.),这或许是在下线阶段获得\\\phi的,但在推论时会增强它,所以他们作为下线获得的方法进入我们的分类学. CL和IPM之间的分界线是\\\phi在部署时是否仍然被扩大.

blocks.en: Table 1: Scope relative to neighboring paradigms. Parametric asks whether the memory takes continuous parameter form. Independent acquisition asks whether it is produced by an independent acquisition operator 𝒜 \mathcal{A} rather than as a byproduct of running the model. Augmented at deployment asks whether it enters the forward pass at deployment as a distinct object. A paradigm is included only when all three hold.
blocks.zh: 表1:与相邻范式有关的范围。 参数询问内存是否采取连续参数形式. 独立收购询问是否由独立的收购经营者A\mathcal{A}生产,而不是作为运行该模型的副产品. 部署时增派人员询问,在部署时它是否作为单独目标进入前方通行证。 只有在三个方面都坚持,才列入一个范式。

blocks.en: Table 2: The operational criteria and typical memory objects of different classes of methods in the two dimensions used to locate included methods.
blocks.zh: 表2:用于定位的两种维度不同方法的操作标准和典型的内存对象.

blocks.en: 3 Two-Dimensional Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 3 二元分类学

blocks.en: To better understand and compare the properties of different IPM methods (Section 5 ), we located the methods that pass Table 1 along two axes: where 𝒞 \mathcal{C} augments ϕ \phi , and when 𝒜 \mathcal{A} forms it, which form the Parameter Placement and Parameter Acquisition Time two taxonomy dimensions. Table 2 states the operational criteria and typical memory objects in each dimension. Figure 3 draws the taxonomy tree and representative methods. In this section, we will discuss how we define these two dimensions. The analysis about the methods in each class will be conducted in Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 为了更好地理解和比较不同的IPM方法的属性(第5节),我们把通过表1的方法按照两个轴来定位:C\mathcal{C}增强\\phi的地方,以及A\mathcal{A}形成时,A\mathcal{A}构成参数放置和参数获取时间两个分类维度. 表2列出了每个维度的操作标准和典型的内存对象. 图3绘制了分类树和代表性方法. 在本节中,我们将讨论如何界定这两个层面。 第4节将分析每一类的方法。

blocks.en: 3.1 Dimension I: Parameter Placement
blocks.zh: 3.1 尺寸一:参数放置

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , the parameter placement dimension is defined by the site at which 𝒞 \mathcal{C} reads ϕ \phi . And according to the families in Section 2.1 , we can divide the parameter placement into four classes: embedding layers, attention layers, FFN layers, and Hybrid. And the typical memory objects for each class are also listed in Table 2 . Different parameter placement corresponds to different memory objects. For example, the memory objects for the embedding layers are usually soft prompts ( Lester et al., 2021 ; Yi et al., 2025 ) , soft tokens ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2026b ) , and memory tables ( Cheng et al., 2026b ; Cheng et al., 2026a ) . And the memory objects for the attention layers are usually encoded KV banks ( Fu et al., 2026b ; Huang et al., 2026b ) , adapters ( Charakorn et al., 2025 ) , fast weights ( Lei et al., 2026 ) , online neural memory ( Behrouz et al., 2026 ) , and soft prompts ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . And the memory objects for the FFN layers are usually adapters ( Su et al., 2025b ) , memory tables ( Xu et al., 2026b ) , online neural memory ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) and fast weights ( Zhao and Jones, 2026 ) . And the memory objects for the Hybrid are usually adapters ( Mind Lab, 2026 ) , online neural memory ( Zhang et al., 2026f ) .
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,参数放置维度由C\mathcal{C}读作\\\phi的站点定义. 根据2.1节中的家庭, 我们可以将参数设置分为四个类别:嵌入层,注意力层,FFN层,和混合层。 而每个类的典型内存对象也列在表2. 不同的参数放置对应不同的内存对象. 例如,嵌入层的内存对象通常是软导体(Lester等,2021;Yi等,2025;),软导体(Zhang等,2026b;Wu等,2026b;),和内存表(Cheng等,2026b;Cheng等,2026a.). 而关注层的内存对象通常被编码为KV库(Fu等,2026b;Huang等,2026b),适配器(Charakorn等,2025b),快重(Lei等,2026),在线神经内存(Behrouz等,2026b),软快活(Wang等,2026b). 而FFN地层的内存对象通常是适配器(Su等,2025b),内存表(徐等,2026b),在线神经内存(张等,2026d)和快重(赵和琼斯,2026. 而混合体的内存对象通常是适配器(Mind Lab,2026),在线神经记忆(张等,2026f.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dimension II: Parameter Acquisition Time
blocks.zh: 3.2 二维:参数获取时间

blocks.en: The parameter acquisition time records when the deployed ϕ \phi is formed: online or offline. The reference is whether ϕ \phi is formed during or before the models’ deployment. The offline-acquired IPM methods are usually based on one-shot acquisition operators, while the online-acquired IPM methods are usually based on stateful acquisition operators. Note that the acquisition time is not when the operator that produces it was trained. For example, a hypernetwork may be trained offline, yet the LoRA it emits for a deployment context is acquired online ( Tan et al., 2025 ) . The typical memory objects for each class are also listed in Table 2 . Online objects are usually fast weights ( Lei et al., 2026 ) , online neural memory ( Behrouz et al., 2026 ) , adapters ( Charakorn et al., 2025 ) , and soft tokens ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Their augmentation operators are usually various forward processes. Offline objects are usually encoded KV banks ( Yu et al., 2026b ) , soft prompts ( Liu et al., 2022 ) , adapters ( Hu et al., 2021 ) , and memory tables ( Cheng et al., 2026b ) . And their augmentation operators are usually their training processes.
blocks.zh: 部署的\\\phi形成时的参数获取时间记录:在线或离线. 参照点是 \\phi 是在模型部署期间或之前形成的。 离线获取的IPM方法通常基于一发收购运营商,而在线获取的IPM方法通常基于状态获取运营商. 请注意,获取时间不是生产该设备的操作人员接受培训时。 例如,一个超网络可能会被从网上培训,而用于部署环境的LORA则是在线获取的(Tan等人,2025年)。 每个类的典型内存对象也列于表2. 在线物体通常为快重(Lei等,2026年),在线神经记忆(Behrouz等,2026年),适配器 (Charakorn等,2025年),和软活字(张等,2026b. 它们的增强运算器通常是各种前向过程. 离线对象通常被编码为KV Bank (Yu等, 2026b.),软提示 (Liu等, 2022),适配器 (Hu等, 2021),和内存表 (Cheng等, 2026b.). 而他们的增强操作员通常是他们的训练过程.

blocks.zh: 图3:哺乳类动物总分类和代表方法。

blocks.en: 4 Method Landscape
blocks.zh: 4 方法景观

blocks.en: Figure 1 gives an introductory demonstration and Figure 3 lists the audited collection used throughout this section. We organize the narrative by placement (Level 1), then by acquisition time (Level 2), matching the taxonomy tree. In this section, we will discuss the details about the methods in each class.
blocks.zh: 图1为介绍性演示,图3列出了本节中所采用的经审计的收集。 我们通过放置(一级),然后通过获取时间(二级),匹配分类树来组织叙述. 在本节中,我们将讨论每一类方法的细节。

blocks.en: 4.1 Embedding Layer
blocks.zh: 4.1 嵌入层

blocks.en: Most of the methods that augment online acquired IPM at embedding layers are based on soft tokens and soft prompts. MemGen ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) equips LLMs with a weaver to synthesize the current hidden state into latent memory tokens that are prepended to the frozen backbone’s input. GradMem ( Kuratov et al., 2026 ) compresses a context into a few prefix memory tokens via test-time gradient descent on a reconstruction loss, also with the backbone frozen. MINT ( Yi et al., 2025 ) maintains a bank of learnable soft prompts that is retrieved and updated online on test samples, adapting CLIP’s input prompts while it serves. REFRAG ( Lin et al., 2025b ) injects compressed chunk embeddings as input-side representations for efficient RAG decoding, selectively expanding chunks as needed. LatentMem ( Fu et al., 2026a ) gives each agent in a multi-agent system a memory composer that distills retrieved interaction trajectories into compact role-aware latent memory tokens. In all these cases the memory object is formed or updated during the inference time, so these methods are classified as online.
blocks.zh: 大多数在嵌入层上增强在线获取的IPM的方法都是以软符和软提示为主. MemGen (Zhang等, 2026b) 装备了LLMS编织器来将当前隐藏状态合成潜伏的内存符号, 准备由被冻结的主干输入. GradMem (Kuratov等,2026年)通过测试时间梯度下降来将上下文压缩为重建损失上的一些前缀记忆符号,骨干也冻结了. MINT(Yi等,2025年)维持一个可学习的软提示库,在测试样品上在线检索和更新,在服务时调整CLIP的输入提示. REFRAG(Lin等,2025年b)注入了压缩块嵌入,作为高效RAG解码的输入-侧表示,并根据需要有选择地扩展块. LatentMem (Fu等, 2026a))给多剂系统中的每个特效一个内存作曲,将所回收的相互作用轨迹分馏成紧凑的角色-意识潜伏的内存符号. 在所有这些情况下,内存对象都是在推论期间形成或更新的,因此这些方法被归类为在线.

blocks.en: Prompt-tuning ( Lester et al., 2021 ) optimizes continuous soft prompts before the deployment and prepend them at inference, so ϕ \phi is composed offline. There are a line of methods using special tokens that are trained offline to integrate external memory. For example, TokMem ( Wu et al., 2026b ) trains procedural knowledge in specialized tokens offline and read at input. H 2 MT ( Haghifam et al., 2026 ) organizes hierarchical memory tree offline and routes each query top-down to read the relevant nodes. MemoryTokens ( Sastre and Rosá, 2025 ) learns reversible sentence representations as a new token in the vocabulary. There are also a line of methods using memory tables or embedding tables that are trained offline for the models to look up. For example, Engram ( Cheng et al., 2026b ) implements conditional N N -gram lookup from input token identities. Memory Grafting ( Cheng et al., 2026a ) builds a frozen N N -gram memory table from an offline grafting model and composes it at inference through longest-match lookup and gated injection. In these cases, ϕ \phi is fixed during the episode but still enters the forward path at inference.
blocks.zh: 即时调音(Lester等,2021年)在部署前优化了连续的软调音符,并在推断时进行预置,因此\\\phi是由离线而成. 使用特殊符号的方法有一行被训练出下线,以整合外部内存. 例如,TokMem(Wu等,2026b.)将程序知识训练为专用代币下线并用输入读取. H 2 MT(Haghifam等,2026年)组织分级内存树下线,并沿每个查询自上而下行走以读取相关节点. MemoryTokens (Sastre and Rosá, 2025) 学习可倒转的句子表述,作为词汇中的新符号. 还有一些使用内存表或嵌入表的方法线,这些方法被训练出下线,供模型向上看. 例如,Engram(Cheng等,2026b.)从输入符身份执行有条件的N-gram查询. 记忆移取(Cheng等,2026a)从离线移取模型中构建了被冷冻的N-gram内存表,并通过最长的相邻取取出和入门注射来作推想. 在这种情况下,\\phi在剧集中被固定,但仍在推论中进入了前进的道路.

blocks.en: 4.2 Attention Layer
blocks.zh: 4.2 注意层

blocks.en: There are a huge amount of test-time training (TTT) methods that augment online-acquired IPM at attention layers, which adapt online neural memory as their memory objects. For example, Titans ( Behrouz et al., 2026 ) and Atlas ( Behrouz et al., 2025 ) learn attention-coupled neural memories at test time. MesaNet ( von Oswald et al., 2026 ) and qTTT ( Bansal et al., 2026 ) perform locally optimal or long-context TTT in attention-side state. Metis ( Zhang et al., 2026e ) pursues a memory-foundation model with online write or read. TTT Layers ( Sun et al., 2023 ) treat the hidden state as a model trained at test time with attention-side recurrence. There are also some works adapting fast weights as their memory objects. δ \delta -mem ( Lei et al., 2026 ) maintains a compact online associative state whose readout corrects attention of a frozen backbone. Infini-Transformer ( Munkhdalai et al., 2024 ) compresses past segments into a fixed-size associative memory matrix that each attention layer reads alongside the local cache. For KV banks as memory objects, these methods usually can obtain dense KV representations that are more than token-level memories. CEPE ( Yen et al., 2024 ) encodes a long context chunk with a small encoder and lets the decoder read the encoded representations through added cross-attention layers. M+ ( Wang et al., 2025b ) composes a query-conditioned memory bank at test time to extend the effective context. C2C ( Fu et al., 2026b ) treats the KV caches encoded by another LLM as the parametric memory and employs a learned cache fuser projects the sharer’s KV cache into the receiver’s attention. PrefixMemory-Tuning ( Wang et al., 2026b ) moves the prefix out of the attention head into an external query-conditioned module, fixing prefix-tuning’s input-prefix tradeoff.
blocks.zh: 有大量的测试时间训练(TTT)方法在注意力层上能增强在线获取的IPM,这些方法能将在线神经内存作为他们的内存对象来适应. 例如"泰坦斯"(Behrouz等,2026年)和"阿特拉斯"(Behrouz等,2025年)在测试时学习了注意力相接的神经记忆. MesaNet (von Oswald等, 2026年)和qTTT (Bansal等, 2026年)在关注-侧状态下进行本地优化或长文本的TTT. Metis (Zhang等,2026e.)以在线写作或阅读来追求内存建立模式. TTT地层(Sun等,2023年)将隐藏状态作为试验时训练的有注意力侧重现的模型. 也有一些作品将快重作为他们的记忆对象来适应. δ\delta-mem (Lei等, 2026年) 保持紧凑的在线关联状态, 其读取修正了被冻结的骨干的关注. Infini 翻译器 (Munkhdalai等,2024年)将过去的片段压缩成一个固定大小的关联内存矩阵,每个关注层与本地缓存一起读取. 对于作为内存对象的KV Bank,这些方法通常可以得到密集的KV表示,这些表示不仅仅是象征级记忆. CEPE(Yen等,2024年)用一个小编码器来编码一个长上下文块,并让解码器通过所添加的交叉注意层来读取所编码的表示. M+ (Wang等, 2025b.)在测试时间组成一个有查询条件的内存库来延长有效上下文. C2C (Fu等, 2026b) 将由另一个 LLM 编码的 KV 缓存作为参数存储器, 并使用已学习到的缓存引信将共享器的 KV 缓存投放到接收者的注意力中. 前缀Memory-Tuning (Wang et al., 2026b)将前缀从关注头移出到外部的有查询条件的模块,固定前缀调取的输入前缀取舍.

blocks.en: A typical offline-acquired IPM method at attention layers is prefix-tuning ( Li and Liang, 2021 ) , for it learns continuous KV representations at each attention layer. There are also more flexible methods (e.g., KBLaM ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , AtlasKV ( Huang et al., 2026b ) , SR-KI ( Yu et al., 2026b ) ) that learns cross-attention heads (projectors) as the acquisition operator 𝒜 \mathcal{A} to project the representations of sentences encoded by a small freeze encoder to the LLMs’ semantic space. They can obtain KV representations of new sentences on the fly. But their knowledge is organized offline, so they are classified as offline methods. MoC ( Tibrewal et al., 2026 ) learns chapter-level memory modules offline that are attached at inference. Memory 3 ( Yang et al., 2024 ) converts a knowledge base into offline trained sparse attention key-value memories and retrieves them into self-attention at inference. Memory Attention ( Kang, 2026 ) drops the value projection and builds each attention value as the contextual key plus a lookup from a layer-specific token embedding table.
blocks.zh: 关注层中典型的离线后获得的IPM方法为前缀调取(李和良,2021),因为它在每个关注层中学习连续的KV表示. 也有比较灵活的方法(如KBLAM(Wang等,2025a),AtlasKV(Huang等,2026b),SR-KI(Yu等,2026b))作为收购运营商A\mathcal{A}学习交叉注目的头(projector),以投射由小冻结编码器编码到LLMS语义空间的句子. 他们可以得到KV在苍蝇上新句子的表示. 但他们的知识是编成离线的,因此被归类为离线方法. MOC (Tibrewal等, 2026年) 学习分章级内存模块离线,这些模块在推论中被附加. 记忆3 (Yang等, 2024) 将一个知识库转换为离线训练的稀有关注键值记忆,并在推论中将其取回为自觉. 内存注意 (Kang, 2026) 降低数值投影,并将每个注意值构建为上下文键外加从层特有符号嵌入表的查看.

blocks.en: 4.3 FFN Layer
blocks.zh: 4.3 FFN层

blocks.en: The methods belonging to this class are usually based on hypernetworks to generate MLP LoRA adapters on the fly. Doc2LoRA ( Charakorn et al., 2026 ) maps a document to LoRA adapters in one pass. The reported implementation adapts MLP down-projections and is therefore FFN. DyPRAG ( Tan et al., 2025 ) dynamically generates parametric adapters from a retrieved document at test time for knowledge enhancement, where ϕ \phi is materialized during the deployment. Locas ( Lu et al., 2026b ) and WISE ( Wang et al., 2024a ) provide locally supported or side-memory mechanisms for continual FFN-side updates at deployment. GRACE ( Hartvigsen et al., 2023 ) wraps an FFN projection with a codebook of key-value adaptors, applying a stored value only when the layer activation falls near a cached key. FwPKM ( Zhao and Jones, 2026 ) introduces fast-weight product-key memory on the feed-forward path. LaCT ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) revisits test-time training with FFN-side state updates.
blocks.zh: 属于这一类的方法通常以超网络为基础来生成在苍蝇上能生成MLP LoRA适配器. Doc2LORA (Charakorn等, 2026) 将一个文档映射到LORA适配器的一通通. 所报告的执行情况适应了MLP的倒数预测,因此是FFN。 DyPRAG(Tan等,2025年)在测试时从检索到的文档中动态地生成参数适配器,以增进知识,在部署过程中实现\\\\\\\。 Locas(Lu等人,2026年b)和WISE(Wang等人,2024年a)为部署时持续提供FFN侧更新提供当地支持或副记忆机制。 GRACE(Hartvigsen等,2023年)用密钥值适配器的编码本来包裹FFN投影,只在地层活化到缓存密钥附近时才应用被存储值. FwPKM (Zhao and Jones, 2026) 在向导路径上引入了快重产品键内存. LaCT (Zhang等, 2026d.)随FFN-side状态更新重新进行测试时间训练.

blocks.en: For offline methods, they usually synthesize some QA pairs from some documents or knowledge bases and train LoRA adapters on the FFN layers with them. For example, PRAG and PolyPRAG ( Su et al., 2025a ; Su et al., 2025b ) encode retrieved knowledge into FFN-side parameters offline and then plug them in at inference. Other methods like MLP Memory ( Wei et al., 2026 ) pretrain an MLP at FFN layers to imitate a k k -NN retriever’s behavior, which internalize retrieval patterns without explicit document access. Similarly, RING ( Xu et al., 2026b ) injects new corpora into mixture-of-memory experts and learns, via reinforcement, the routing-and-search policy that reads them at inference. MemoryLLM ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Jaiswal et al., 2026 ) trains the FFN only on context-free token embeddings, so the whole layer collapses into a precomputable token-wise lookup. Sparse memory finetuning ( Berges et al., 2024 ) writes new facts into the most selectively activated slots of a memory-layer model via masked gradient updates, leaving the addressable table to be read by top- k k lookup at inference. These compose ϕ \phi at deployment and are offline-acquired core.
blocks.zh: 对于离线方法,它们通常会从一些文档或知识库中合成出一些QA配对,并用它们来在FFN地层上训练LORA适配器. 例如,PRAG和PolyPRAG(Su等人,2025年a); Su et al., 2025b) 将检索到的知识编码为FFN-侧参数下线后再插入推断. 其它方法如MLP Memory(Wei等,2026年)在FFN地层预排出一款MLP来模仿一款k-NN取回器的行为,在没有明确文档访问的情况下将取回模式内部化. 同样地,RING(徐等,2026年b)将新的蝎子注入了记忆混合专家中,并通过强化来学习在推论中解读它们的通路和搜索政策. MemoryLLM (Wei等, 2026; Jaiswal等, 2026) 只在无上下文符号嵌入上下文的情况下对FFN进行训练,因此整个地层会倒塌为可预估的以符号为主的取景. Sparse内存微调(Berges等,2024)通过蒙面梯度更新将新事实写入内存层模型最有选择性地被激活的插槽中,留下可地址表由top-k k lookup来读取推论. 这些由部署时的\\phi组成,是离线的核心。

blocks.en: 4.4 Hybrid
blocks.zh: 4.4 混合状态

blocks.en: Unlike the FFN-side methods above, Hybrid methods train linear layers at more than one site: not only inside the FFN, but also at other modules such as attention heads.
blocks.zh: 与上面的FFN-侧式方法不同,"混合"方法在不止一个站点进行线性地层训练:不仅在FFN内部,而且在关注头等其它模块中进行.

blocks.en: Temp-LoRA ( Wang et al., 2024b ) trains temporary multi-site LoRA during inference. SHINE ( Liu et al., 2026a ) maps a context to per-layer LoRA adapters in one forward pass of an in-context hypernetwork, so later queries answer from those adapters without rereading the context. AbsorberLLM ( Zhang et al., 2026f ) synchronizes causal state for test-time training across sites. Doc2Atom ( Diao et al., 2026 ) compiles documents into composable semantically typed memory atoms spanning multiple modules.
blocks.zh: 临时洛拉 (Wang等,2024b.) 在推论期间,列车临时多站LORA. SHINE(Liu等,2026a)将一个上下文映射到每个层的LORA适配器上,一个前行通过一个上下文的超网络,所以后来询问这些适配器的回答,而不重读上下文. AbsorberLLM (张等, 2026f.) 将测试时间训练的因果状态同步到不同地点. Doc2Atom (Diao等, 2026) 将文档编译为可相容的 semantally地打入跨越多模块的内存原子.

blocks.en: Standard LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) is hybrid when attention and FFN maps are adapted together. Macaron-V1 ( Mind Lab, 2026 ) routes each turn to one specialist LoRA on a frozen base, so skills stay plug-in adapters. KnowLa ( Luo et al., 2024 ) injects frozen knowledge-graph entity embeddings into hidden states through a small adapter trained alongside LoRA. LatentSkill ( Yu et al., 2026a ) compiles textual skills into LoRA adapters offline that are mounted on a frozen backbone at inference.
blocks.zh: 标准LORA (Hu等, 2021年) 当注意力和FFN地图一起被调整时是混合的. Macaron-V1 (Mind Lab, 2026) 路线各转而由冷冻地基上的一个专家LORA来操作,因此技能保持插入适配器. 认识拉 (Luo等人,2024年)通过与LORA一起训练的小适配器将被冻结的知识图实体嵌入隐藏状态. LatentSkill (Yu等, 2026a.) 将文本技能编译为LORA的离线适配器,在推想中被挂在被冻结的主干上.

blocks.en: 5 Property-Based Comparison
blocks.zh: 5 财产比较

blocks.en: In this section, we will compare the methods in each class based on their properties, for example, task purpose, materialization, persistence, and memory write or read cost, which decide how such an IPM object can be used. And we also list these properties in Table 4 for each representative method. We also summarize each representative method’s parameter placement of 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , the memory object, and the acquisition operator 𝒜 \mathcal{A} in Table 3 . Note that we use qualitative bands because the underlying papers rarely report comparable FLOPs or wall-clock numbers.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们将根据每个类的属性来比较方法,例如任务目的,可实现性,持久性,以及内存书写或读取成本,这些成本决定如何使用这种IPM对象. 我们还在表4中列出每种代表性方法的这些属性。 我们还总结了表3中C\mathcal{C}、内存对象和收购操作员A\mathcal{A}的每个代表方法的参数位置。 请注意,我们使用质量波段,因为基础文件很少报告可比的FLOP或相上下行时数.

blocks.en: As the tables suggest, online rows are almost always per-request or per-token and ephemeral or session-scoped, where generated adapters and soft prompts pay a medium-cost one-pass write for a fresh object, while recurrent fast weights and online neural memory pay a low-cost per-token write to keep a mutable state for long-context modeling. Offline rows are almost always pre-deployment and persistent, where they pay a high-cost one-time write to freeze knowledge into soft prompts, KV banks, or memory tables, and then read at low-cost cost. Methods with the same IPM object type also behaves differently by parameter acquisition time. Adapters are cheap when generated online, but expensive when trained offline. Encoded KV banks are composed per request in CEPE and M+, but precomputed in KBLaM and AtlasKV.
blocks.zh: 如表格所示,在线行几乎总是按要求或按键或按键、按键或按会话范围排列,生成的适配器和软提示为新对象支付中成本的一通写法,而经常性快重和在线神经内存则支付低成本的每通写法,以保持可变状态来进行长文本模型. 离线行几乎总是在部署前并持续地,在那里他们支付高成本的一次性写作,将知识冻结为软提示,KV银行或内存表,然后以低成本阅读. 使用同一种IPM对象类型的方法也因参数获取时间而表现不同. 适应器在线生成时价格低廉,但离线培训时价格昂贵. 编码的KV银行按CEPE和M+中的请求组成,但预先计算为KBLAM和AtlasKV.

blocks.en: 5.1 Trade-offs
blocks.zh: 5.1 取舍

blocks.en: Based on the above analysis, we can summarize the trade-offs between IPM methods. For the parameter acquisition time axis, online acquisition adapts immediately but pays higher write-time compute. Offline acquisition is more stable and validated, yet cannot absorb a new stream without an offline training process. For the parameter placement axis, embedding-side objects are the cheapest to compose, because they enter through the input stream with the backbone frozen, but their influence is indirect, mediated by every layer above. Attention-side objects are content-addressable: the query-key reads support both associative lookup over large banks and recurrently updated states, at the cost of coupling to head structure and attention budget. FFN-side objects write into the layers where factual associations are stored, so edits can directly overwrite specific behaviors. However, the read is position-wise, which means each token consults the memory independently, with no content-based selection among entries and sequential writes to shared weights interfere. Hybrid stacks compose objects across sites and are the most expressive, shaping both what the model reads and how it computes. However, observed behaviors can not be traced to a single component, so updates must be coordinated across heterogeneous objects.
blocks.zh: 基于上述分析,我们可以总结IPM方法之间的取舍. 对于参数获取时间轴,在线获取立即适应,但支付更高的写入时间计算. 离线采购更为稳定和有效,但如果没有离线培训程序,就无法吸收新流。 对于参数放置轴来说,嵌入侧面对象是最便宜的作曲对象,因为它们通过输入流以主干被冻结入内,但其影响是间接的,由上方的每个层来进行调解. 注意边对象可处理内容:查询键读取支持对大银行和经常更新的状态进行联合查询,其代价是与头部结构和注意力预算相配合。 FFN-侧对象会写入存储事实关联的地层,因此编辑可以直接覆盖特定的行为. 然而,读取是位置取而代之的,这意味着每个信使独立地查阅内存,在条目中没有基于内容的选择,并依次写出共享权重来干涉. 混合堆放物构成跨站点的物体,并且是最有表现力的,既塑造了模型读取的内容,也塑造了模型的计算方式. 然而,被观测到的行为无法被追溯到一个单一的组件上,所以更新必须在多相异的物体之间进行协调.

blocks.en: Besides, ICL and ICL-based RAG remain preferable for the tasks needing exact quotation, provenance, targeted deletion, or human revision, which are trivial for a text store, hard once text is compressed and abstracted into ϕ \phi .

blocks.en: 6 Open Directions
blocks.zh: 6 开放方向

blocks.en: The comparison above exposes some gaps in the current landscape. We highlight four open directions for the IPM paradigm.
blocks.zh: 上文的比较暴露出当前情况中的一些差距。 我们强调国际植物检疫模式的四个开放方向。

blocks.en: Interference and forgetting. Sequential edits and recurrent delta-rule writes overwrite earlier associations, and the damage grows with the update sequence: edited weights increase in norm and disrupt general-ability directions, while a fixed state interferes along the current key ( Gupta et al., 2025 ; Lyu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Lei et al., 2026 ; Hatamizadeh et al., 2026 ) . Subspace projections, norm constraints, and erase or write gates slow this collapse, but they keep a growing record of past keys or gate only the current key, so conflict detection and fixed-capacity allocation over a long stream remain open ( Wang et al., 2026c ) .
blocks.zh: 干扰而忘. 序列编辑和反复出现的三角规则会覆盖更早的关联,而破坏会随着更新序列而增加:被编辑的重量在规范上增加并会扰乱一般的可读性方向,而固定状态会干扰当前键沿(Gupta等,2025;Lyu等,2026;张等,2026a;Lei等,2026;Hatamizadeh等,2026). 子空间预测,规范约束,并擦去或写出门来减缓了这次倒塌,但它们只保留了不断增长的过去键或门的当前键的记录,因此在长溪上的冲突探测和固定容量分配仍然开放(Wang等,2026c.

blocks.en: Safety-aware acquisition. One write from untrusted context is later retrieved as trusted knowledge, and current memory systems do not record provenance ( Dash et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026 ) . When the write is parametric, IPM objects can implant the behavior in weights, and behavioral unlearning leaves traces, so update budgets, provenance-conditioned write gates, and privacy-aware consolidation remain open ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 安全意识获得. 一个来自不信任上下文的书写后来被取回作为可信赖的知识,而目前的内存系统并不记录出处(Dash等,2026;Zou等,2026.). 当书写为参数时,IPM对象可以将行为植入权重中,行为不学会留下痕迹,因此更新预算,出处条件的书写门,隐私意识的整合仍然开放(Chen等,2026;Hong等,2025;Wang等,2026a).

blocks.en: Co-design with ICL. ICL keeps memory as textual tokens, which can represent more detailed information. Although compressed memory objects in IPM can lead to efficient augmentation, there are still cases that need fine-grained memory access. So the open direction is a co-design in which 𝒜 \mathcal{A} decides what stays in context and what enters ϕ \phi , and 𝒞 \mathcal{C} reads both in one forward pass.
blocks.zh: 与ICL共同设计. ICL将内存作为文字符号保存,这可以代表更详细的信息. 虽然在IPM中被压缩的内存对象可以导致高效的增强,但仍有一些案例需要精细的内存访问. 因此开放方向是共同设计,其中 A\ mathcal{A} 决定上下文中的内容和输入 \\ phi 的内容, C\ mathcal{C} 在前传中同时读取 。

blocks.en: Model-native recursive self-improvement (RSI). Most recursive self-improvement today lives in the agent harness, where prompts ( Fernando et al., 2023 ) , skills ( Liu et al., 2026b ) , knowledge bases ( Tang et al., 2025 ) , and tools ( Lu et al., 2026a ) are revised outside the model ( Ni et al., 2026 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) . A model-native version would let 𝒜 \mathcal{A} write useful deployment experience into ϕ \phi itself, so the backbone model improves in-parameter and the gap between offline training and online inference narrows.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This survey analyzes in-parameter memory augmentation for LLMs, which is a more efficient and model-native way to augment LLMs than the ICL paradigm. We organize in-parameter memory along parameter placement and acquisition time, and lay out the resulting landscape. We formulate the paradigm with a memory object, an acquisition operator, and a composition operator, and use them to draw explicit boundaries. We also discuss the open directions for the IPM paradigm to help future parametric memory systems.
blocks.zh: 这项调查分析了LLMs的参数内存增强,这是比ICL范式更有效和模型化的方法来增强LLMs. 我们按照参数的放置和获取时间来组织参数内存,并列出由此产生的地貌. 我们用一个内存对象、一个收购操作员和一个组成操作员来制定范式,并用它们来划定明确的界限。 我们还讨论了IPM范式的开放方向,以帮助未来的参数记忆系统.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: This survey has the following limitations. First, it only considers the IPM paradigm under text-modality. There are also plenty of works applying the IPM paradigm to other modalities, such as vision, audio, and video. Second, it does not include IPM designs built into newer LLM architectures, such as Mixture of Latent Experts (MLE), Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), and Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC). Third, the comparison does not under numerical measurements. Write cost, read cost, and retention are qualitative bands inferred from mechanisms, because the source papers rarely share a benchmark or comparable measurements.
blocks.zh: 这项调查有以下局限性。 首先,它只考虑文本模式下的IPM范式. 还将IPM范式应用于视觉、音频和视频等其他模式的作品也很多。 其次,它不包括被更新型的LLM架构所构建的IPM设计,如Latetent Expert (MLE),多头Latet recent (MLA),和Manifold-Constructive Hyper-Connections (mHC). 第三,在数字测量下不作比较。 写作成本,读取成本,和保留是从机制中推断出来的定性波段,因为出处论文很少共享基准或可比较的测量.
